ideas.title: Farm the Fault Line 🌋
ideas.hook: Your farm sits right on a fault line. Every few minutes an earthquake splits the ground, and the cracks are where the best crops grow.
core_loop: Plant seeds on your plot
Survive the quake as cracks open across the farm
Replant in the fresh cracks for rare 'quake' crops
Harvest and sell for cash
Buy braces, deeper soil and bigger plots
ideas.twist: Quakes reshape your plot each round: cracks are rich soil but can swallow buildings, so you choose between protecting your barn and planting in the danger zone.
ideas.why_now: Grow × Disaster is the top gap in the data (score 6.79). Grow / farm is the fastest rising mechanic at 1.92 (up 0.49 this week, 52 new games, 100,897 CCU) led by [🐜] Ant Evolution (25,123) and Throw a Seed (13,378), and Disaster / weather is the top rising theme at 2.47 with Stop The Tsunami! (11,923).
ideas.differentiator: Disaster games make you flee; here the disaster plows your field and decides where rare crops can grow.

ideas.title: +1 Crane Height 🏗️
ideas.hook: You are a robot crane. Every lift gives +1 height, and a taller arm can grab and fling bigger things across the map.
core_loop: Grab a crate, car or ragdoll with your claw
Each lift gives +1 crane height
Fling what you grabbed for distance cash
Rebirth for a stronger motor
Unlock heavier zones (cars, buses, tanks)
ideas.twist: Height changes what you can reach: tall cranes can pluck other players off rooftops and toss them into the next zone.
ideas.why_now: +1 × Robots / mechs is the second biggest gap (4.86). The "+1 ___" formula sits at 1.9 momentum (37 new games) with [🌍UPD 5] +1 Venom Evolution (9,066) and +1 Boxing Battle Evolution (6,951). Robots / mechs is rising at 1.92 (up 0.32) with untitled ragdoll game (9,011), and Hit / swing / launch is at 1.44.
ideas.differentiator: +1 games stack a number on the player; here the number is a visible crane arm that changes what you can grab and fling.

ideas.title: Be a Quake Fixer 🔨
ideas.hook: Run the repair shop in a town that shakes every night. Patch walls, sell supplies, and hope your own shop survives the next quake.
core_loop: Take repair jobs on cracked houses
Sell planks, glass and braces from your shop
Upgrade tools and hire helper NPCs
Survive the nightly quake inside your shop
Expand to bigger buildings with bigger payouts
ideas.twist: The bigger the quake, the more you earn the next morning, but quakes also damage your shop shelves, so you brace your stock before night falls.
retention: Daily quake forecast with bonus jobs
ideas.why_now: Sell / run a shop × Disaster is a top gap (4.35). Sell / run a shop is rising at 1.23 (35 new games) with Sell Fries! [Anomaly] 🍟 (9,553) and Sell a Million Sushi (4,505), Disaster / weather is at 2.47 with Stop The Tsunami! (11,923), and the "Be a ___" formula is at 1.37 (⚽ Be a Soccer Legend, 6,861).
ideas.differentiator: Shop games are calm; here a disaster creates the demand and threatens the shop that sells to it.

ideas.title: Build a Crash Ramp 💥
ideas.hook: Draw and build your own stunt ramp, then send cars down it and watch them smash with real crash physics.
core_loop: Build a ramp from pieces on your lot
Pick a car and launch it
Score cash for distance, flips and damage
Unlock new ramp parts and heavier cars
Share your ramp for other players to try
ideas.twist: Other players' cars can be launched onto your ramp, and every crash on your build pays you a cut, so the best ramps become busy tourist spots.
ideas.why_now: Physics Sim is the fastest rising subgenre at 2.83 (up 0.67, 32 new games, 151,198 CCU) led by Hyper Realistic Ragdoll (45,310). Vehicle Sim is at 1.44 with BloxNG [CRASH PHYSICS] 💥 (22,059), Paint / create is rising at 1.65, and the "Build a ___" formula is at 1.3 (Build Your World! 🔨, 12,350).
ideas.differentiator: Crash games give you fixed maps; here players build the stunt tracks and earn from other players' wrecks.

ideas.title: Escape the Airstrike ✈️
ideas.hook: Planes fly over and drop bombs in waves. Run, dive and ragdoll to the shelter before the last strike hits.
core_loop: Spawn on the far side of a war map
Run as bombing waves sweep the field
Dive into trenches or bunkers to survive
Reach the shelter to win the round
Spend medals on speed and dive upgrades
ideas.twist: Explosions launch you with ragdoll physics, so a near miss can fling you ahead or back to the start.
ideas.why_now: Escape / run × Military / war is a top gap (4.12). Escape / run is rising at 1.46 (39 new games, 85,654 CCU) with Stop The Tsunami! (11,923) and 13 Days to Escape [ALPHA] (9,352), Military / war is at 1.63 with Voxel Wars (15,506) and Ragdoll Wars! (6,798), and the "Escape ___" formula is at 1.09.
ideas.differentiator: War games are about shooting; here you have no gun and the whole map is the hazard.

ideas.title: Build a Scarecrow Army 🧟
ideas.hook: Grow scarecrows from seeds in your field. By night they wake up and fight off the zombies coming for your crops.
core_loop: Plant scarecrow seeds and water them
Harvest grown scarecrows with random weapons
Place them around your farm
Defend against the nightly zombie wave
Sell zombie loot for better seeds
ideas.twist: Scarecrows grow with mutations: a pumpkin-head can explode, a corn-cob can shoot, so planting is your army builder.
monetization: Luck pass for rare scarecrow mutations
ideas.why_now: Grow / farm × Zombies is a top gap (3.89). Grow / farm is rising at 1.92 (up 0.49) with [🐜] Ant Evolution (25,123) and [2x WEEKEND] Farm Evolution (9,857), Fight / battle is at 1.1 (up 0.31), Zombies is at 1.17 with Build to Fight Zombies (3,951), and the "Build a ___" formula is at 1.3.
ideas.differentiator: You grow your defenders instead of buying them, so the farm and the army are the same thing.

ideas.title: Punt the Giant for Cash 🦶
ideas.hook: A giant ragdoll is asleep in your yard. Kick it as far as you can, earn cash per stud, and grow strong enough to punt bigger giants.
core_loop: Charge up and kick the giant
Earn cash for distance and bounces
Each kick gives +1 leg power
Unlock bigger giants worth more
Rebirth for kick multipliers
ideas.twist: The giant lands across colored zones that pay different amounts, and sometimes wakes up and kicks you back.
ideas.why_now: Hit / swing / launch is rising at 1.44 (52 new games, 161,400 CCU) led by Realistic Ragdoll MMA 🥊 (16,008) and Throw a Seed (13,378). Giant / huge is at 1.72 (28 new games) with Pull a Dino 🦖 (5,434), Physics Sim is at 2.83, and the "___ for ___" formula is at 1.11.
ideas.differentiator: Launch games throw small objects; here the projectile is a huge ragdoll with physics that makes every kick look different.

ideas.title: +1 Gravity Gun 🪐
ideas.hook: Fight on a tiny moon with a gravity gun. Every hit gives +1 pull, until you can yank asteroids out of the sky and drop them on rivals.
core_loop: Shoot rivals to push or pull them
Each hit gives +1 gravity power
Grab space junk and asteroids to throw
Knock players off the moon for points
Rebirth into bigger planets
ideas.twist: Low gravity means every shot sends players flying, and a strong enough gun can pull the whole crowd into one spot.
ideas.why_now: Shooter is up 0.58 this week to 1.4 (36 new games, 168,474 CCU) with Ragdoll Physics 🩸 (27,367) and Voxel Wars (15,506). Space is rising at 2.44 with [🛸] Sweep The Moon 🌕 (7,242), and the "+1 ___" formula is at 1.9 with +1 Boxing Battle Evolution (6,951).
ideas.differentiator: Shooters deal damage; this gun moves things, so the arena itself becomes the weapon.

ideas.title: Be a Dragon Banker 🐉
ideas.hook: Run the bank inside a dragon's cave. Knights, wizards and goblins deposit treasure, and you keep the dragon happy so it doesn't eat the customers.
core_loop: Serve customers at the counter
Store their gold in the vault
Feed the dragon from your earnings
Upgrade the vault and hire goblin tellers
Unlock rarer customers with rarer loot
ideas.twist: The dragon sleeps on the hoard: the more gold in the vault, the bigger it grows, and the higher the payout if you keep it calm.
ideas.why_now: Sell / run a shop × Fantasy / medieval is in the gaps (2.96). Sell / run a shop is at 1.23 with Sell Fries! [Anomaly] 🍟 (9,553) and [UPD 2] Barber Simulator (4,514), Money / rich is at 1.81 (76 new games) with [🐟] Net a Fish! (18,877), and Interiors / corridors is the rising map style at 1.72.
ideas.differentiator: Shop games serve normal customers; here the business is built on a dragon that grows with your success.

ideas.title: Build a City Smasher 🏙️
ideas.hook: Build your own giant monster out of blocks, then take control and stomp through a voxel city that breaks apart piece by piece.
core_loop: Build a monster from blocks in your workshop
Take it into the city
Smash buildings for cash and blocks
Spend blocks on bigger limbs and powers
Unlock bigger cities with tougher buildings
ideas.twist: Your design decides how it moves: long legs step over buildings, heavy arms crush harder, and bad builds fall over.
ideas.why_now: Sandbox is rising at 2.02 (up 0.37) with Build Your World! 🔨 (12,350) and Sandworm Playground (11,726), Voxel / blocky is the top rising art style at 2.21 with Unstable SMP FFA [JAVA PVP!] (16,881), Giant / huge is at 1.72, and Break / mine / dig is at 1.4.
ideas.differentiator: Destruction games give you a set monster; here you build it, and the build decides how it smashes.
